title: Bid writer
description:
We are seeking an experienced Bid Writer with a proven track record of managing and writing successful tender responses for both UK and US public and private sector opportunities. The successful candidate will be responsible for leading the entire bid lifecycle, from opportunity identification and qualification through to submission, clarification, negotiation, and contract award.



The role requires exceptional writing, project management, and stakeholder engagement skills, with the ability to produce compelling, compliant, and high-scoring tender submissions.



Key Responsibilities



Tender Management



* Manage the full tender process from opportunity identification to contract award.

* Review tender documentation, specifications, RFQs, RFPs, ITTs, PQQs, SQs, and framework agreements.

* Conduct bid/no-bid assessments and provide recommendations to senior management.

* Develop bid strategies and win themes aligned with client requirements.

* Coordinate bid activities and submission timelines.



Bid Writing & Content Development



* Produce high-quality, persuasive, and compliant tender responses.

* Write and edit technical, operational, quality, social value, safeguarding, and management responses.

* Tailor responses to UK government procurement requirements and US federal/state procurement processes.

* Maintain and develop bid libraries, case studies, and supporting evidence documents.

* Ensure all responses align with evaluation criteria and scoring methodologies.



Stakeholder Management



* Work closely with subject matter experts, operational teams, finance departments, and senior leadership.

* Gather technical information and transform it into clear, compelling tender content.

* Facilitate bid meetings and manage contributor deadlines.



Compliance & Submission



* Ensure all submissions meet procurement regulations and client requirements.

* Manage online procurement portals and tender systems.

* Complete supporting documentation, pricing schedules, declarations, and compliance requirements.

* Coordinate tender clarifications and post-submission communications.



Continuous Improvement



* Conduct bid reviews and lessons learned exercises.

* Analyse feedback from unsuccessful and successful bids.

* Improve bid processes, templates, and content repositories.



Essential Skills & Experience



* Minimum 3+ years’ experience as a Bid Writer, Proposal Writer, or Tender Manager.

* Demonstrable experience writing successful UK and US tender responses.

* Experience managing tenders from initial opportunity through to award.

* Strong understanding of public sector procurement processes.

* Experience with:

    * Invitation to Tender (ITT)

    * Request for Proposal (RFP)

    * Request for Quotation (RFQ)

    * Selection Questionnaires (SQ)

    * Dynamic Purchasing Systems (DPS)

    * Framework Agreements

    * Federal, State, and Local Government Procurement

* Excellent written English and proofreading skills.

* Strong project management and organisational abilities.

* Ability to work under pressure and manage multiple deadlines.

* Advanced Microsoft Office skills.



Desirable Experience



* APMP Certification.

* Experience within Education, Healthcare, Recruitment, Social Care, Construction, Facilities Management, or Professional Services sectors.

* Knowledge of UK Procurement Act requirements and US government procurement procedures.

* Experience using procurement portals including:

    * Find a Tender Service (FTS)

    * Contracts Finder

    * Jaggaer

    * Proactis

    * Delta eSourcing

    * Bonfire

    * 



Candidate Profile



The ideal candidate will have a proven history of successfully delivering winning bids and tender submissions across both UK and US markets. They will be highly organised, commercially aware, and capable of managing the complete bid lifecycle independently. The successful applicant will demonstrate excellent attention to detail, strategic thinking, and the ability to produce persuasive responses that maximise tender scores and increase contract win rates.

title: Paralegal/Attorney – Criminal Defense
description:
Position Overview:

We are seeking a skilled and detail-oriented Paralegal or Attorney to support our criminal defense practice. This role requires in-depth knowledge of criminal law, including motion preparation, legal research, and document management. The ideal candidate will be responsible for preparing motions, drafting legal documents, and ensuring compliance with legal procedures. They will work closely with attorneys to ensure the defense strategy is executed effectively, and help prepare cases for court. This is a remote position requiring exceptional written English, organizational skills, and a strong grasp of U.S. criminal law procedures fundamentals.



Key Responsibilities:



• Draft, review, and be prepared to file various legal documents including motions, briefs, and memoranda.

• Prepare appendices for motions, including organizing exhibits, declarations, and supporting documentation.

• Prepare the table of contents for legal filings, ensuring accuracy and compliance with court rules.

• Conduct in-depth legal research on complex criminal law issues and generate a research summary for the attorney.

• Analyze discovery materials to identify critical issues and inconsistencies.

• Prepare memoranda and case summaries to aid in litigation strategy.

• Assist in the preparation of motions for hearings, trials, and appeals, including motions to suppress evidence, dismiss charges, or modify bail.

• Manage case files, ensuring all relevant documents and evidence are properly documented and stored.

• Prepare discovery responses, subpoenas, and other legal documents as directed.

• Coordinate with clients, witnesses, and experts to gather information and evidence for cases.

• Maintain communication with the court, opposing counsel, and clients regarding motions, hearings, and court dates.

• Provide support during trial preparation, including organizing exhibits, trial briefs, and witness lists.

• Ensure all legal documents comply with applicable state and federal rules and deadlines.



Qualifications:



• Must be a Graduate of a law school (JD).

• Proven experience in criminal defense law, specifically in motion practice.

• Strong knowledge of court rules, procedures, and legal writing standards.

• Experience preparing appendices, tables of contents, and organizing large case files.

• Excellent research, analytical, and writing skills.

• Must have strong knowledge of legal citation

• Ability to manage multiple cases and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.

• Strong communication skills and attention to detail.

• Experience with legal research tools (e.g.,Lexis/Nexis and Westlaw) and document management software, such as Clio CRM software.



Preferred:



• Prior experience in criminal defense law or litigation.

• Knowledge of specific motions in criminal defense, including motions to suppress, dismiss, and motions for bond 

        reductions.

• Familiarity with Nevada local court rules and procedures in criminal defense.



Application Process:



Interested candidates should submit the following:

• An updated resume.

• A cover letter detailing your experience with U.S. criminal law and Clio software.

• Two writing samples (legal motions or briefs preferred) with how long it required the applicant to finalize the presented 

        document (in hours) from the time the assignment was given to the document presented.

title: Elite AI Video Creator & Avatar Architect — Zen Companies Inc.
description:
What if the most powerful AI videos on the internet had your name on them?



Zen Companies Inc. is the force behind $40M+ in client revenue, 500+ transformed businesses, and one of the most advanced AI automation platforms on the planet. We don't follow trends — we set them. Our team spans 15+ countries, our systems run 24/7, and our standards are relentless.



Now we're building something new: a next-generation AI video production engine. And we need the creative weapon to lead it.



We're searching for an Elite AI Video Creator & Avatar Architect — someone who doesn't just use AI video tools but commands them. Someone who can take a blank prompt and turn it into a cinematic masterpiece. Someone who sees Higgsfield, Veo 3, and Sora not as novelties, but as instruments in their creative arsenal.



If that's you, keep reading. This is your mission.



---



THE MISSION



You will be the creative engine behind Zen's AI-generated video content. You will concept, direct, generate, and edit video assets that stop the scroll, build trust, and convert audiences — all powered by the most advanced generative AI models available today. You will also design and deploy custom AI avatars that become the face and voice of brands.



This is not a "make a few clips" role. This is full ownership of a production pipeline at the frontier of what's possible.



Your Objectives:



• Master the Models. Generate hyper-realistic, cinematic-quality video using Higgsfield, Google Veo 3, OpenAI Sora, and emerging platforms. You know the strengths, limitations, and optimal prompting strategies for each.



• Architect Custom AI Avatars. Design, train, and deploy lifelike AI avatars with flawless lip-sync, natural gestures, and distinct brand personalities. Experience with HeyGen, D-ID, custom ComfyUI avatar pipelines, or equivalent tools is essential.



• Own the Full Pipeline. From creative concept and storyboarding through prompt engineering, generation, compositing, and final edit — you deliver polished, publish-ready video from start to finish.



• Edit Like a Pro. Seamlessly blend AI-generated footage with traditional editing techniques in Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, CapCut, or After Effects. Color grade, sound design, and pace every piece to perfection.



• Stay Ahead of the Curve. The AI video landscape changes weekly. You will be our scout — testing new models, discovering new workflows, and integrating breakthroughs before the competition even knows they exist.



• Collaborate with a World-Class Team. Work alongside our CTO, creative designers, media buyers, and automation engineers to produce content that fuels campaigns across Meta, TikTok, YouTube, and beyond.



---



THE ARSENAL YOU NEED



We're looking for someone with a proven, demonstrable track record — not just enthusiasm. Here's what separates the elite from the average:



Must-Have Skills:

• Deep, hands-on proficiency with Higgsfield, Google Veo 3, OpenAI Sora, and at least two other AI video generation platforms

• Proven experience creating custom AI avatars with realistic lip-sync and natural motion

• Advanced prompt engineering skills — you know how to write prompts that produce consistent, controllable, cinematic results

• Strong foundation in professional video editing (Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, After Effects, or CapCut)

• Understanding of visual storytelling — composition, pacing, lighting, color theory, and emotional impact

• Excellent English communication skills (written and verbal)



Bonus Skills That Set You Apart:

• Experience with ComfyUI, Stable Diffusion video workflows, or RunwayML

• Motion graphics and kinetic typography

• Sound design and audio engineering for video

• Experience producing content for paid advertising (Meta Ads, TikTok Ads, YouTube Ads)

• Familiarity with AI voice synthesis tools (ElevenLabs, etc.)



---



THE REWARDS



Zen doesn't just hire talent — we invest in it. Here's what you get when you join the team:



• Up to $10.00 USD/hour — competitive, reliable compensation paid on time, every time

• Unlimited AI Tool Access — every subscription, every platform, every model you need to do your best work. We arm you with the best.

• Work from Anywhere — fully remote, flexible schedule. Your output matters, not your location.

• Join an Elite Team — collaborate with 20+ dedicated professionals across technology, creative, media buying, and automation

• Continuous Growth — access to Zen Elevations Academy and ongoing training to keep your skills razor-sharp

• Be at the Frontier — this isn't maintenance work. You'll be pioneering workflows that don't exist yet, at a company that lives and breathes AI innovation



---



HOW TO APPLY



We value precision and attention to detail. To prove you have both:



1. Start your application with the phrase: "Cinematic AI"

2. Include a link to your portfolio or demo reel showcasing AI-generated video work and custom avatar examples

 has 8,542 followers but only 142 posts — 8.5× fewer than Sora Schools (comparable follower count, 1,214 posts). Cadence is far below every competitor we benchmarked.

title: Tiktok Expert
description:
About bina



bina is an online school for ages 4–15, building a category-defining learning experience for families that want more than what traditional or other online schools offer. We're a small, fast-moving team, currently scaling enrollment ahead of our peak intake season (Aug–Sep 2026). The next 3–4 months are when the year is made.



Mission

???? This is a reach + lead-generation role, not a follower-count role. TikTok's job for bina is to get in front of parents who don't know us yet and drive them to lead capture (bio link, DM automation). Reach without lead capture is vanity for bina. If a video can't be tied to either discovery of the right parent or a path to a lead, it's not worth making.



Context



- Parents are the audience, not kids. We sell through parents — they're the decision-makers. Kids' content competes with Moonbug-scale brands and doesn't convert. Every video is made for a parent making a schooling decision. Content for kids: We’ll explore that later after we solve the parent egagement.

- bina is "faceless" to kids — TikTok content relies on parent-facing talent, teachers on camera (with consent), voiceover + B-roll (hands, art, screens, projects), text-overlay opinion videos with trending audio, and screen recordings of the learning platform.

- TikTok's algorithm is discovery-first (FYP), not follower-first. A small account can reach a huge audience if the hook + format works — which is exactly the opening for a small team. Reach is earned per-video, not banked in a follower count.

- bina has a TikTok account but it's underused — no systematic content engine, no lead capture from the channel. Greenfield.

- Cross-posting relationship: most TikTok content can be repurposed as IG Reels + YouTube Shorts. The Community & Social Media Specialist role handles daily cross-posting; **you own TikTok-specific strategy and optimization** — hooks, trends, sounds, format, retention — not the cross-platform posting logistics.

- We've already mapped 17 verified TikTok creators in bina's influencer target map (selected for cultural fit to our parent personas, not raw follower count) — a lever for seeding and collaboration if you want it.



Deliverables



- Build the system that finds winning TikTok formats for parent-targeted education content — trend monitoring, outlier analysis, the hook patterns that survive the FYP for our ICP.

- Build the content engine: TikTok-native formats for a faceless brand — text-overlay opinion with trending audio, voiceover + B-roll, teacher-on-camera, screen recordings, trending-sound adaptations. Sustainable cadence, not heroic bursts.

- Build the hook + retention playbook. TikTok lives or dies on the first 2 seconds and watch-through rate. Document the patterns that work for parents making a schooling decision, so the team can reuse them.

- Build the lead-capture bridge. Bio link optimization, DM automation triggers, comment-to-DM flows that turn reach into Close leads. Coordinate with the Automation Specialist + Community & Social Media Specialist on the plumbing.

- Build the trend-response system: how fast we can turn a trending sound or format into on-brand bina content without losing our voice or our compliance footing.

- Lock the cross-posting strategy with the Community & Social Media Specialist (TikTok ? IG Reels ? YouTube Shorts) and the Video Editor (production direction).

- Source attribution: every bio link / CTA tagged via dub.co for clean Close attribution. Coordinate with the Tracking specialist.

- Optionally activate the 17 mapped TikTok creators for seeding / collaboration where it accelerates reach.

- And related tasks.



Must-have proof (be ready to share)



A B2C TikTok account you've grown with measurable reach + lead generation (NOT vanity follower count), ideally from a small or faceless starting point. Send the handle, the reach numbers, and the lead-gen path (bio link clicks, DM conversions, sign-ups).

title: Simple Screen Recorder & Video Assembler (Repetitive Task / Part-Time)
description:
The Role:

We are a software tutorial publisher looking for a reliable, detail-oriented Virtual Assistant to record and assemble simple, 2-to-3-minute "How-To" tutorial videos.



IMPORTANT: This is NOT a creative video editing job. You do not need to add effects, transitions, or graphics. This is a highly repetitive, assembly-line-style task. If you enjoy simple, clear, repetitive workflows, this is for you.



Your Daily Workflow:



You will be given a list of video topics, MP3 voiceovers, and reference video links.



You will watch the short reference video to see what to click.



You will open the target website/software and use a screen recorder (like OBS) to repeat the exact same clicks on your screen.



You will drop your screen recording and the provided MP3 voiceover into CapCut, sync them together, and cut out any dead space.



Export the MP4 and upload it to our Google Drive.



The Volume & Workload:



This is a high-volume pipeline. You will be required to assemble an average of 30 to 45 short videos per day.



Because the videos are very short and the process is identical every time, this becomes very fast once you learn the system.



Work is assigned on a week-by-week basis. Depending on our content pipeline.



Compensation (Performance-Based):

This is a flexible, task-based contract paid weekly.



Weekly Base Pay: $50 USD per week (for a 5-day workload).



Performance Bonus: You will receive an additional 20% bonus ($10) every single week if your video quota is met on time with zero audio sync errors.



Total Potential Earnings: $60 USD per week.



Payments are made promptly via PayPal.



Requirements:



A reliable PC/Laptop capable of running OBS (or similar screen recorder) and CapCut smoothly.

Extreme attention to detail (making sure the mouse clicks match the voiceover perfectly).



Excellent English comprehension to follow written Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).

Minimum of 3–5 years experience in product development, account management, or a similar role.

Skills & Competencies

Strong project management and organizational skills.

Excellent written and verbal communication abilities.

Strategic thinker with an eye for detail and a proactive approach to problem-solving.

Ability to handle multiple projects and deadlines while maintaining high-quality standards.

Skilled in supplier negotiation and relationship management, especially in global markets.

Strong analytical skills with the ability to use data to drive decisions and improvements.

Experience working with international suppliers and distributors (e.g., U.S., Europe, Middle East).

title: Financial Operations Manager (Commercial Accounting / Full-Cycle / Xero / CPA Preferred / Manila Based)
description:
Job Description



Company: Priority Haulage Limited

Job Title: Financial Operations Manager

Job Type: Part-Time

Job Hours: ~25 Hours Per Week

Job Location:  Remote (Manila-based candidates only)

Reports to: Financial Controller

Start Date: June/July



About Priority Haulage



Priority Haulage is a reputable and reliable heavy machinery and equipment transport business based in Auckland, New Zealand. We specialise in the safe and efficient transportation of a wide range of civil machinery and heavy access equipment. 



Our company motto, “Your Assets, Our Priority”, reflects our commitment to the secure and dependable movement of our clients’ valuable machinery. We take pride in delivering a high level of client satisfaction through trusted service and operational excellence.



Job Summary



Priority Haulage is seeking a reliable and capable Financial Operations Manager to oversee day-to-day finance operations and support the monthly close process within a lean, systems-focused environment.



This is a hands-on role focused on maintaining accurate financial records, supporting month-end reporting, and ensuring finance workflows operate smoothly and efficiently.



Role Overview 



This role suits someone organised, dependable, systems-minded, and comfortable working autonomously within a structured operational environment.



Availability & Working Hours

This role requires consistent daily coverage during New Zealand morning business hours, with a structured morning schedule and flexible, outcome-focused afternoon support. Philippine Time (PHT) is typically 4 hours behind NZT (5 hours during NZ daylight saving).



Core Daily Hours (NZT)

9:00 AM – 12:00 PM NZT (5:00 AM – 8:00 AM PHT)

These hours are required each business day and cover core financial operations, daily processing, reconciliations, payroll coordination (Monday only), and communication with the New Zealand team.



The operational finance workload during this period is expected to be manageable within these core hours under normal operating conditions.



Month-End & Management Accounts Cycle

Additional hours are required during the monthly close process.



This includes:



• Close preparation during the final 1–2 business days of the month; and

• Completion of the monthly management accounts package within 8 working days following month-end.



During this period, responsibilities include:



• Reconciliations

• Working papers

• Management accounts preparation

• Review updates

• Close-related coordination



This workload is expected to average approximately 20–25 hours per month depending on the cycle and business activity.



Flexible Support & Process Improvement

Outside core operational and month-end responsibilities, additional flexible hours may be available to support:



• Finance process improvements

• Reporting and documentation enhancements

• Workflow optimisation

• Additional reconciliation and operational finance support as required



These hours will be agreed based on operational priorities and the successful candidate’s capability and availability.



Job Responsibilities



Bookkeeping & Financial Operations

• Perform day-to-day bookkeeping activities in Xero.

• Manage the general ledger and maintain the chart of accounts.

• Complete all required financial reconciliations accurately and on time.



Payroll Administration

• Review approved driver timesheets.

• Process weekly payroll, submit payments, and manage IRD filings.

• Ensure payroll accuracy and compliance with New Zealand standards.



Supplier Management

• Manage supplier accounts, payments, reconciliations, and resolve queries.

• Coordinate subcontractor bills and ensure accurate reconciliation.

• Oversee recurring subscriptions, licensing, registrations, and compliance costs.



Client Management

• Issue client statements and prepare, manage, and communicate job quotations.

• Resolve client account, billing, and payment enquiries.

• Support accounts receivable and debt collection activities via the Client Services Coordinator.



Operational Support & Continuous Improvement

• Drive process improvements, system optimisation, and efficiency opportunities.

• Collaborate cross-functionally to support timely, high-quality workflows.

• Partner with leadership to ensure accurate, reliable finance data.



Reporting & Compliance

• Prepare monthly management accounts, reconciliations, and reporting using Xero and CCH Workpapers, ensuring accuracy and timely month-end close. 

• Support GST preparation and adherence to New Zealand accounting standards. 

• Maintain financial data integrity, documentation standards, and contribute to ongoing reporting improvements.



Required Experience & Capability



Applicants should demonstrate proven experience operating in a structured, deadline-driven finance environment.

• Minimum 7+ years’ hands-on accounting experience.

• CPA qualification required, preferably a Regular Member of PICPA, with a recognised tertiary qualification in accounting.

• Advanced proficiency in Xero is essential.

• Strong Microsoft Excel capability, with proven ability to reconcile and analyse data using XLOOKUP/VLOOKUP, INDEX/MATCH, pivot tables, and financial modelling functions.

• Proven experience preparing monthly management accounts, conducting financial analysis, and supporting budgeting and forecasting activities.

• Working knowledge of New Zealand tax regulations, accounting standards, and statutory compliance requirements.

• Demonstrated ability to operate independently in a remote environment, with strong self-management, reliability, and a consistent track record of meeting deadlines without oversight.

• Strong ability to collaborate cross-functionally, supporting finance-related workflows across the business.

• High level of technical proficiency, including the Microsoft platform, with working familiarity in modern business tools.



Preferred Experience 



• Experience within New Zealand or Australian Chartered Accounting firms, including use of CCH Workpapers.

• Exposure to a commercial business environment, ideally within transport, logistics, or fleet-based operations.

• Experience using Notion, ChatGPT, and modern workflow/documentation tools within an operational business environment.

• A relevant tertiary qualification in finance, business administration, or a related field.



Personal Attributes



• Highly organised and detail-oriented, with the ability to manage multiple responsibilities reliably.

• Strong communication and interpersonal skills, able to operate autonomously while contributing effectively in a remote team environment.

• Analytical and problem-solving capability, particularly in identifying, investigating, and resolving financial discrepancies.

• Proactive and improvement-oriented, with the ability to adapt, optimise workflows, and navigate operational change.

• Professional, client-focused mindset, demonstrating integrity, quality standards, and accountability in delivery.



Required Equipment and Setup



• Dedicated Workspace: Quiet, distraction-free home office suitable for video calls and focused work.

• Computer & Internet: Desktop PC or laptop with minimum Intel Core i5 processor, 8GB RAM (16GB preferred), Windows 10/11 compatibility, and a stable high-speed internet connection (minimum 10 Mbps upload/download).

• Monitor Setup: Dual monitors, or a laptop paired with an external monitor.

• Headset: Noise-cancelling headset for clear communication during virtual meetings where operating outside a fully quiet workspace.

• Webcam: High-quality external or integrated camera for video calls.

• Power Backup: Uninterruptible Power Supply (UPS) or generator ensuring at least 3 hours of operational uptime during outages.

• Internet Backup: Secondary internet connection (e.g., mobile data or alternative wireless) for uninterrupted connectivity.



Application Requirement

In your application submission, include the word “Motivated!” in the title.

title: Part-Time Virtual Assistant (Online Deal Hunter, Caption Writer & Collage Maker) **Women Only**
description:
Overview:



We are specifically looking for a female Virtual Assistant who understands women's style, midsize fashion trends, and home organization style. The main responsibility for this role is to actively hunt for the best daily deals, major discounts, and top-rated product finds across major American online stores like Amazon, Walmart, Target, and Nordstrom. Once these deals are found, you will be responsible for creating clean, nice product collages in Canva and writing engaging, conversational captions to feature them in our deals and finds group.



What is the job like?:



To give you an idea, it’s just like finding what's currently on sale, trending, or the best finds and vouchers on apps like TikTok Shop and Shopee, but for an American setting. You will be hunting for the best sales, deals, fashion finds, and home organization items on major American online stores like Amazon, Walmart, Target, Nordstrom, and more. Once you find them, you'll put them into collages and write catchy, natural captions to share them with our deals and finds group.



This role starts as part-time, but as the workload expands and you master the tasks, it can quickly turn into a full-time opportunity. You will be trained and supported by another PH VA who can guide you in Tagalog.



General Responsibilities:

*Online Deal Hunting: Search American retail sites (Amazon, Walmart, Target, Nordstrom, etc.) to identify top-rated items on sale, major discounts, and "look-for-less" products.

*Caption Writing & Content Creation: Draft natural, engaging social media captions for our deals and finds group, highlighting why the product is a must-have and what the selling point is (great price, high quality, utility, etc.).

*Collage Creation: Save product images and create clean, nice product collages in Canva.

*Basic Organization: Keep our curated selections, images, and Canva folders neatly organized and updated daily using Google Sheets and Google Drive.





Requirements:



*Loves shopping: Genuinely enjoys browsing online stores, looking at retail trends, and hunting for great discount finds.



*Fluent in Conversational English: Must be able to write in a friendly, natural, and engaging tone that connects with an American audience (no formal or robotic AI-sounding copy) that makes a product attractive and can clearly communicate its key selling points to a group.



*Detail-Oriented & Reliable: Good at communication, organized, able to follow guidelines, stay on task, and manage daily responsibilities without skipping steps. Please submit your application and make sure to start your application with “I love shopping” so I know you read the entire posting.



*Teachable: Open to feedback, eager to learn our standard formatting formulas, and ready to adapt to our daily workflow.



*Comfortable using Canva, Google Sheets, and Google Drive.



*Has a reliable internet connection.



If you love finding the best deals online, enjoy writing, and want a long-term role where you can grow, please submit your application!

title: Supply Chain Specialist
description:
Supply Chain Specialist – E-commerce

Join Our Growing supply chain team at Roots & Branches

Hi there! We're on the lookout for an experienced Supply Chain Specialist who knows what it takes to run a tight replenishment operation — especially for Amazon and multi-channel e-commerce businesses. Do you thrive on managing inventory and getting products on time against the lowest costs to our sales channels? Then we’d love to meet you.



________________________________________



About Roots & Branches

At Roots & Branches, we are passionate about enhancing well-being through high-quality health products. As a fast-growing European brand group, we sell across Amazon, our own webshops & Bol with our 5 different brands. But well-being doesn't stop at our customers, we care just as much about our team. That's why we invest in our company culture through regular personal calls where we stay connected as people, not just colleagues. And to keep everything running smoothly behind the scenes, a strong, reliable supply chain is critical to our success and that's where you come in.



________________________________________



About the role

In this role you will report directly to the senior supply chain coordinator for operational questions, who is based in The Philippines as well. Next to that, you’re in direct contact with the supply chain manager about possible improvements and projects. Mondays and Tuesdays tend to be the busiest days of the week due to creation of the replenishments. The other remaining days you will be monitoring shipments, collecting data and improving processes. We’re seeking for a pro active colleague that is constantly searching for improvements. Preferably that colleague has experience with AI as we want to minimize the repetitive tasks.





What You’ll Do



You'll support and strengthen our Supply Chain department with responsibilities like:

• Replenishment Management

Plan and execute shipments to Amazon FBA and Bol warehouses across Europe, United States and United Kingdom.

• Data management

Make sure that the data that we use to make decisions is accurate. This varies from monitoring direct D2C shipments, shipping costs as well as following up on reimbursements

• Inventory Monitoring

Track stock levels across multiple platforms to prevent stockouts and overstocking.

• Issue Resolution & Stress-resistant

Communicate clearly and promptly with warehouses, logistics providers, and internal teams to solve any supply chain hiccups.

________________________________________

What We’re Looking For

• 3+ years in supply chain operations, preferably in an e-commerce and Amazon FBA environment.

• Someone that is eager to learn and that is able to manage their own tasks individually.

• Strong experience with replenishment planning and inventory management across multiple channels.

• Excellent English communication skills — written and spoken.

• Proficient in Google Sheets, Excel, or similar tools (bonus for experience with inventory management systems).

• Someone that is willing to work till 10 / 11 PM to create overlap with our Europe team (this means you will start in the afternoon)

________________________________________

Mindset

• Highly organized and detail-oriented.

• Proactive problem solver — you spot issues before they escalate.

• Team player who communicates openly and takes ownership of responsibilities.

• Flexible and fast — you’re comfortable working in an environment where priorities can shift.

• Always looking for improving current processes. Preferably in combination with AI.



Bonus Points (not required but nice to have)

• Experience with inventory planning software (e.g., Inventory Planner, Cin7, NetSuite, etc.).

• Worked at an e-commerce aggregator, brand, or agency.

________________________________________

What We Offer

• A fast-growing, entrepreneurial environment where your ideas and work have real impact.

• Salary in the range of $1000 - $1500 per month + performance-based bonuses.

• Full-time, fully remote role (Philippines-based applicants preferred).

• 40-hour work week with flexible working hours.

• Health insurance & pension fund contributions.

• 25 paid holidays per year.

________________________________________

How to Apply (we only consider people that filled in the form)



Please fill out this form:

In the final question of the form, mention the word Orange, before you paste the link of your video, to show us you read the full job description. Applications without this comment will not be considered.

title: A-Player DM Setter for High-Ticket Men’s Coaching (Uncapped Commission)
description:
Read this carefully. If you’re just looking for “any VA job” or fixed hourly pay, this is not for you.



I’m Stefan, founder of Status Alpha – a high-ticket mentorship for men who want elite body, energy, mindset and performance.



We sell €3.5k–€20k coaching programs to men worldwide. Most clients come from DM conversations.

We are already flooding the market with content across Instagram,
, TikTok, YouTube, LinkedIn and X, and the volume of inbound + outbound conversations is only going up.



I have a full Content Operating System and A-Player closers.



Now I want an A-player setter whose only job is:

Start smart conversations. Qualify fast. Book calls. Get paid on results.



If that excites you, keep reading.



Mission of the Role:

Turn warm attention from my content into qualified booked calls for my sales team.



You will:



- Own DMs on non-bot platforms (TikTok, LinkedIn, YouTube, maybe others).

- On Instagram/Facebook, take over stuck / high-intent leads when the existing flows and automations have done their part and a human is needed.

- Proactively initiate DMs with warm leads (engagers, commenters, voters) when directed by the team.

- Follow proven scripts and flows, adapt when needed, and track results.

- Be measured on:

--> Conversations started

--> Calls booked

--> Show-up rate

--> Sales from your sets



This is appointment setting, not closing. No cold calling, no “spray and pray.” You talk to people who already follow/engage with me.



What You’ll Actually Do (Daily):

- Check all assigned platforms multiple times per day (TikTok, LinkedIn, YouTube, plus IG/FB stuck/high-intent leads).

- Reply to inbound messages using our scripts and training.

- Start DMs with warm leads, for example:

--> People who comment with clear pain/interest

--> Story viewers/voters (when handed to you)

--> Engagers on high-performing posts that we flag for you

- Qualify leads using our questions (budget, problem, timeline, fit).

- Handle basic objections at the DM level (time, “not sure”, “need to think”), and route serious buyers to a call.

- Book calls on the correct calendar, with all required notes.

- Keep your own simple tracking updated so we always know:

  - Who you talked to

  - Who booked a call from your DMs

  - Who showed up

  - Which of those calls became paying clients (you’ll see this from our CRM for commissions)

  - Who bought (for commissions)

- Follow up on old leads consistently (you will not “forget” people).

- Occasionally reply to high-intent comments (e.g. “how do I work with you?”) and move those people into DMs.

(Low-level comment engagement is handled by a VA, not by you.)

- Work closely with me + my team to improve scripts based on what you see in the field.



You will not be responsible for content creation, editing, or generic admin. Your job is DMs and booking calls.



Who This Is For:

You’re a fit if:



- You love sales conversations and messaging. DMs don’t drain you; you enjoy them.

- Written English is 9/10+. You can sound natural, not robotic.

- You have proven experience as a DM setter / appointment setter / closer (bonus if for coaches/consultants/fitness).

- You can show proof – numbers, screenshots, client references, or case studies – that you’ve actually booked calls and driven revenue before.

- You’re hungry. You want uncapped income, not just a tiny fixed salary.

- You like being measured. Numbers don’t scare you.

- You can work Philippines evenings to overlap with my time (Dubai) and US/Europe prospects.

- You are okay working 6 days/week with lighter Sundays. Content + attention won’t stop on weekends.



Nice-to-have (but not required):

- Certificates in appointment setting / sales (e.g. setter/closer programs). If you have them, send them – they’re a plus, not a must.



This is NOT for you if:

- You’re scared of rejection or “pushback” in DMs.

- You want to “learn sales someday” but have zero reps and zero proof.

- You need someone to tell you every minute what to do.

- You’re just collecting clients and will disappear in 30 days.



Compensation:

This is performance-driven.



- Base: $200–$300/month (depending on experience)

- Commission: 3–5% of cash collected from clients who buy after calls you set

--> Our programs are €3,500–€20,000

--> Even at the low end, 3–5% is ~$110–$300+ per sale

- Realistic OTE once ramped:

--> 15–25+ calls booked/month,

--> 30–40% close rate by our closers,

You can make $800–$1,800+ / month once you’re dialed in.



There is no cap. If you blow it up, you earn more. Simple.



Schedule:

- Approx. 35–40 hours/week spread across:

--> Mon–Sat: core setting hours in the evening PH time (to be agreed)

--> Sun: lighter check-ins + follow-ups



You must be available during agreed core hours, not “whenever.”



Minimum Requirements:

- At least 1 year of experience in appointment setting / DM setting / sales (coaching, agency, SaaS, or similar).

- Very strong written English (we will test this).

- Stable internet + backup (data/second connection), and a quiet place to work.

- Comfortable using:

--> Instagram /
 / TikTok / LinkedIn / YouTube DMs

--> Google Sheets / basic CRM

--> Loom / Zoom for training

- Willing to follow proven scripts AND give feedback to improve them.



How to Apply (Follow Instructions Exactly):

1. Subject line / OnlineJobs message title:

A-PLAYER SETTER – [Your First Name]



2. In your message, include short, direct answers to:



a) Briefly describe your best DM setting or sales experience (1–3 sentences).

b) What was your best month ever in terms of calls booked or revenue generated, and for what kind of offer?

c) On a scale of 1–10, how strong is your written English? Show me with 2–3 sentences selling me on why I should pick you.

d) What monthly income are you aiming for in USD within 3–6 months if you crush it here?

e) Confirm your typical working hours in PH time and your availability on Sat/Sun.

f) Attach or link proof that you’re a killer in DMs:

- Screenshots, metrics, or a simple breakdown (e.g. “20 calls booked / 7 closes on $5k offer in one month”),

- Any certificates in setting/sales you have (optional but a big plus).



3. OPTIONAL (big plus):

Record a 2–3 minute Loom or audio where you:

-> Introduce yourself

-> Tell me about a time you turned a dead lead into a booked call

-> Explain why you’re the best choice for this role



Any generic “dear sir” or copy-paste applications will be ignored. I’m only looking for 1–2 killers who want to grow with the brand long term.



If you read this all the way down and you’re fired up, apply now.

title: Client Operations Coordinator
description:
DeepSky is committed to results-oriented individuals who are ready to contribute to our mission of providing financial literacy to entrepreneurs in the US. We are currently hiring a Client Operations Coordinator to manage the flow of client communication and internal execution. If you're someone who can bring structure to a busy inbox, make decisions without waiting to be told, and take ownership of how things get done, consider joining our team.



This role sits at the center of the team. You'll be the first person to read incoming client messages, d
 what they actually need, turn those needs into tasks, and make sure those tasks get completed on time. You will be communicating directly with US-based clients on a daily basis.



This is not a traditional admin or support role. You'll be making real decisions about priority, escalation, and timing every day.

Your responsibilities will include, but are not limited to:



+ Client Communication & Task Flow:

Reading and acknowledging all incoming client messages in the shared inbox

Interpreting client requests and determining priority

Converting requests into clear, trackable tasks

Assigning tasks to the appropriate tea
mbers and ensuring accountability



+ Execution & Follow-Through:

Tracking progress across multiple open client requests

Following up internally to ensure deadlines are met

Escalating early when something is at risk of delay

Ensuring no client issue is left without visibility, ownership, or a next step



+ Onboarding & Coordination:

Supporting new client onboarding by organizing information and tracking timelines

Coordinating across tea
mbers to keep handoffs clean



+ Client Delivery Call Support:

Attending client delivery calls to stay informed on each client's situation, ongoing work, and recent discussions

Managing meeting logistics: admitting attendees, sharing documents during the call, and supporting the host as needed

Taking clear, structured meeting notes that the team can rely on afterward

Capturing action items, follow-up tasks, and key client context for use in later communication

You are not expected to lead financial discussions, but you must be able to follow English-language business conversations and understand what is being d



+ Process Improvement:

Identifying bottlenecks in how work flows across the team

Suggesting and helping implement better internal systems over time



+About You:

You're organized, proactive, and comfortable making decisions even when information is incomplete. You communicate clearly and confidently in English with US-based clients in real time, both in writing and on calls, and you can follow business conversations comfortably without needing things repeated or simplified. You're able to manage multiple open tasks at once and keep things moving without being told. You take ownership of outcomes, not just task completion. You have a basic understanding of financial concepts such as cash flow and P&L, but you're not expected to perform analysis. Detail-oriented and reliable, you're a quick learner who cares about doing things properly.



+Additional Requirement:

Please include your resume and answers to the two short questions below when you apply. We care about how you think, not how polished your writing is. Short, specific answers are better than long generic ones.



You're welcome to use AI as a tool. Much of this role is written communication, so if you can use AI to write clearly and professionally, that's the same quality our clients will receive. We see that as a skill, not a shortcut.



However, the final interview will test your real-time English ability directly, since AI cannot help you on a live call with a US client. We're looking for people who can do both: use AI well in writing, and hold their own in conversation.



We will follow up on your answers during the interview.



1. Tell me about a recent week at your current or most recent job where things did not go to plan. What broke down, what did you do about it, and what would you do differently next time? Please use a real example. (3 to 5 sentences is enough.)



2. Three things land on your desk at 9am Monday morning. A long-time client asks a routine question they want answered by Wednesday. A newer client sends a vague message that suggests they're confused about something we delivered last week. A teammate Slacks you for urgent help reviewing materials before their 2pm client call today. You can only start with one. Which do you pick, and why? (2 to 3 sentences.)



Applications that do not include answers to both questions will automatically be excluded from consideration.



During the initial 3-month trial period, candidates will undergo educational and training sessions. Afterward, successful candidates will be offered full-time positions with comprehensive company benefits.

This position requires working 9am to 6pm US Pacific Time, Monday to Friday, to support our US-based clients and internal team. For candidates based in the Philippines, this translates to 12am to 9am Manila time, Tuesday to Saturday (with Sunday and Monday as your days off). Please only apply if you are able and willing to work this schedule consistently long-term. Flexibility outside of these hours is welcome, but core availability during US Pacific business hours is mandatory.



+Success Metrics during the trial period:

All client messages acknowledged within 24 hours

All client requests converted into trackable tasks with clear ownership

No client issue left without visibility, ownership, or a next step

Demonstrated ability to prioritize independently across multiple competing requests

title: Creative Strategist – Direct Response / Meta Ads (Supplement Brand)
description:
**ABOUT THE ROLE**



We are a fast-growing supplement brand. We are looking for our first Creative Strategist to join the team and own the ideation and strategy behind our Meta Ads creatives.



This is a ground-floor opportunity. You will be the first creative strategist in the team, working directly with the founder. As the brand scales, your earning potential scales with it.



---



**WHAT YOU WILL DO**



You will be responsible for the full creative strategy process — from research to brief delivery:



- Conduct avatar and market research (Reddit, YouTube, Amazon, competitor ad libraries) to extract real insights and identify what the market wants

- Map awareness stages and identify angles, hooks and content formats to test

- Generate hypotheses for creative concepts based on data — not guesses

- Analyze competitor ads to identify winning formats, structures and messaging patterns

- Ideate and develop 5 to 10 well-structured creative concepts per week

- Write detailed creative briefs for the video editor and graphic designer via Notion

- Work collaboratively within our production process to ensure briefs are clear, actionable and aligned with the strategy



You will NOT be editing videos or designing graphics. Your job is to think, research, and brief.



---



**WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR**



- Proven experience in direct response advertising — ideally Meta Ads for e-commerce or supplement brands

- Deep understanding of awareness stages, avatar mapping, and angle development, formats

- Ability to extract marketing insights from raw research and turn them into testable hypotheses

- Experience analyzing competitor creatives and identifying what makes them work

- Strong written communication — your briefs need to be clear enough that a video editor can execute without additional explanation

- Familiarity with Notion or willingness to work within our existing workflow

- Self-directed and proactive — we move fast and need someone who can keep up



---



**OUR PROCESS**



You will be integrated into a lean, structured workflow:



1. Weekly research and insight gathering on assigned avatars and angles

2. Hypothesis generation and concept ideation

3. Brief creation in Notion for video editor and graphic designer

4. Review and iteration based on ad performance data

5. Direct communication with the founder on strategy and priorities



Everything runs through Notion. You will always know what is expected and when.



---



**HIRING PROCESS**



Before any paid engagement, we ask for a short free trial task. We will provide you with a real brand example and ask you to generate a research-based creative hypothesis. This is not busywork — it is how we evaluate the way you think, not just what you know.



If your thinking aligns with ours, we move forward.



---



**COMPENSATION**



We start with a per-concept payment model — you get paid for every approved creative concept delivered.



As the relationship develops and output is consistent, we transition to:

- Fixed monthly retainer + Performance bonus for every ad that hits a defined spend threshold in the Meta Ads account



This is a real performance-based opportunity. The brand is new, the product is validated, the market is large.



The first creative strategist who comes in and helps us scale will earn significantly more than a standard flat-rate position — because their bonus grows as the brand grows.



---



**TO APPLY**



Send us:

1. A short note on your background and why direct response advertising

2. Some example of a creative concept you developed — what was the insight behind it and what was the result

3. Your rate expectation per concept



No cover letters. No fluff. Show us how you think.

WHAT YOU BRING

• Proficiency in GHL, social media, and admin tools

• Philippines-based, available SGT hours (GMT+8)

• Proactive problem-solver who anticipates needs

• High attention to detail, zero tolerance for errors

description:

direct-to-consumer brands. We run a high volume of video and static ads

across Meta 
/Instagram) and TikTok for multiple clients, and we

need an AI creative who can take a brief and turn it into finished,

scroll-stopping ads — fast, and across different brand styles.



This is a hands-on production role. You'll work on several brands at once,

so you need to switch gears quickly and keep quality high under deadlines.

If you love AI creative tools and get a kick out of making ads that

actually convert, keep reading.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Edit short-form UGC video ads for Meta & TikTok (hooks, captions,

  pacing, B-roll, music, sound design)

- Generate AI UGC videos using avatar tools (HeyGen or similar)

- Create AI animation / motion clips for product and explainer ads

  (Veo, Kling, Runway)

- Design static picture ads and variations (Nano Banana / Gemini,

  Midjourney, Photoshop, Canva)

- Adapt to each client's brand style, voice, and guidelines

- Produce multiple variations of winning ads for testing

- Add AI voiceover (ElevenLabs) and clean, readable captions

- Keep assets organized and labeled per client

- Juggle multiple brands and hit weekly output quotas



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

- 1+ year editing short-form video (CapCut, Premiere, or After Effects)

- Hands-on with at least a few AI creative tools — any of: HeyGen, Veo,

  Kling, Runway, Higgsfield, Midjourney, Nano Banana / Gemini, ElevenLabs

- A real eye for what makes someone stop scrolling (hooks, pacing, captions)

- Can switch between different brand styles without losing quality

- Fast, reliable, communicates every day

- Follows briefs exactly and asks questions when something's unclear

- Good written English

- A computer that can handle editing + stable internet



BONUS POINTS

- Agency or direct-response / DTC ad experience

- You can design statics AND edit video

- You know Meta Ads specs and what a winning ad looks like

- You can write your own hooks and captions



HOURS & SETUP

- Starts part-time (around 15–20 hrs/week) and grows to full-time as our

  client load increases and you prove you're a fit

- This is a grow-into-it role: start small, earn more hours

- 100% remote

- Some overlap with US hours preferred



PAY

- Starting rate TBD — based on experience and hours (we'll discuss it

  in the interview)

- Reviewed after 90 days + performance bonuses for ads that win



HOW TO APPLY (read carefully — we ignore copy-paste applications)

1. Change the subject line to: "I make scroll-stopping AI ads"

2. Send your portfolio or 2–3 sample ads (video and/or static)

3. List which AI tools you've actually used and what you made with each

4. Tell us in one sentence what makes a short-form ad stop the scroll

5. Tell us your expected rate to start (part-time) — per hour or per month



Applications that skip these steps won't be reviewed.

 — our financial intelligence and fractional CFO platform supporting e-commerce founders worldwide.



We've scaled past $2M+/month with a global team, and we're targeting multi 9-figures. The next 12–24 months will be defined by capital allocation, margin expansion, and disciplined scaling decisions — and that's exactly where this role lives.



Learn more at 
dia



Our Core Values

GENIUSES & OWNERS We partner with builders who think like founders. Not finance people waiting for instructions — operators who see a margin problem, build the model, and walk into the CEO's office with a recommendation.



ITERATIONS > HOURS We don't measure success by time at your desk. We measure it by how fast you can pressure-test a hypothesis, refine the forecast, and turn data into a better decision. Build it. Stress-test it. Improve it. Repeat.

The Role

This is not a traditional finance reporting role. This is a builder role for someone who wants to operate as a Fractional CFO across an entire portfolio of businesses.



You will:

Sit at the right hand of the CEO as a strategic thought partner

Own financial strategy across multiple brands and 

Drive decisions on capital allocation, scaling, pricing, and profitability

Manage and develop the Finance Manager (your direct report)

Build the financial backbone that allows us to scale to multi 9-figures without losing control of the numbers

If you've been the smartest finance person in every room and you're tired of presenting reports to leaders who don't act on them — this is your seat.



What You'll Own

Strategic Finance & FP&A

Own financial strategy across all business units (multiple DTC brands + SaaS)

Build and maintain advanced financial models — actuals reporting, forecasting, scenario planning, cash flow projections

Translate complex financial data into clear, actionable decisions for the CEO and leadership

Prepare investor-ready materials and supporting analysis as needed

Unit Economics & Performance

Analyze CAC, LTV, contribution margin, operating margin, and blended ROAS across brands

Deliver weekly and monthly performance insights that drive real decisions

Identify margin leaks, inefficient spend, and cost optimization opportunities before they become problems

Capital & Cash Flow

Manage cash flow planning across multiple entities

Drive capital allocation decisions — where to invest, where to cut, where to scale

Implement financial reporting structures that give leadership a real-time view of the business



Leadership & Operations

Manage and develop the Finance Manager — ensuring strong execution of accounting operations and reporting

Support pricing, margin, and operational efficiency initiatives across departments

Partner with department leads to align financial reality with operational decisions



What We're Looking For

5–10+ years in finance with proven leadership experience

Strong e-commerce / DTC experience — non-negotiable. You understand how this industry actually makes money.

Deep expertise in financial modeling and forecasting — not just maintaining models, but building them from scratch

Strong grasp of unit economics and the growth levers that move the business

Direct experience working with founders or operators — not just middle management

Advanced Excel / Google Sheets skills — modeling, scenario analysis, automation

Operator mindset — you don't just analyze, you make calls

Sharp communicator — you can take a 50-line P&L and make a CEO understand the one thing that matters in 30 seconds



Bonus Points

Experience operating in a Fractional CFO capacity

Experience managing multiple entities, brands, or business units

SaaS finance experience alongside DTC

Experience managing and developing junior finance talent

Comfort with 
 or similar e-commerce financial intelligence tools

Resonance with our mission to build faith-led, traditional, value-driven brands



This Role Is NOT For:

People who want to be told what to do

Reporters who track the past but can't predict the future

Finance people who hide behind spreadsheets instead of making recommendations

Anyone who needs ego massaging or office politics

People uncomfortable with founder-level directness or pushing back when leadership is wrong

Anyone looking for a clock-in, clock-out role

People who don't resonate with our mission of building traditional, faith-led, value-driven brands

If you read those bullets and felt defensive, this isn't the role for you. Move on. If you read them and thought "finally, a place that gets it" — keep reading.



Compensation & Benefits

Base Salary: $3,000 USD/month (full-time)

Performance-Based Bonuses:

Individual Monthly Bonus: Up to 25% of monthly salary based on company Operating Profit %, with double bonus % as a Department Lead (up to 50%)

Quarterly Profit Pool: Equal share of the Employee Profit Pool (2.0%–7.5% of operating profit, scaling with monthly gross sales)

Long-term profit and/or equity incentives for the right person



Other Benefits:

Fully remote

European team orientation

Direct line to the CEO — your work moves the business

Front-row seat to scaling multiple 8–9 figure brands plus a SaaS platform



Our Hiring Process

Screening / Task Test — A short, role-specific exercise to see how you actually think

Founder Interview — Direct conversation with the CEO

Ready to Apply?

 ]

P.P.S. We're not the biggest, but we're building something that matters. If a mission to build faith-led, traditional, value-driven brands resonates with you — you've found your team.

Media Buyer - Meta & Performance Marketing

About Rescale Media



We're not just another e-commerce company. We're a brand incubator on a mission to build enduring, value-driven brands that bring meaningful products into families' lives.



We've scaled from just drop shipping to a 30+ person team doing $1M+/month. Our goal? Multi 9-figures. And we're just getting started.



Learn more at 
dia



Our Core Values



GENIUSES & OWNERS



We partner with builders who think like founders. Not employees waiting to be told what to do—owners who see a problem and fix it.



ITERATIONS > HOURS



We don't measure success by time at your desk. We measure it by how fast you can test, learn, and improve. Ship it. Learn. Repeat.



TRUTH OVER EGO



We prioritize honesty and clarity, even when it's uncomfortable. No politics. No BS. Just data and results.



The Role



We spend serious money on Meta ads—and we need someone who treats every dollar like it's their own.

Maintain ROAS targets while scaling spend

Create clear performance reports and insights for leadership

Stay ahead of platform changes and test new features



What We're Looking For



2+ years of hands-on Meta Ads experience

Proven track record of managing $50K+/month in ad spend profitably

Deep understanding of Meta's algorithm, attribution, and optimization

Strong analytical skills—you live in the data

Experience with creative testing frameworks (you know a hook from a headline)

E-commerce experience preferred (DTC brands a plus)

Experience with $100K+/month spend

Background in creative strategy or copywriting

You've scaled campaigns from test budgets to 6-figure monthly spend

Experience with other platforms (TikTok, Google, Taboola) is nice but not required



This Role Is NOT For...



We're being direct because we respect your time:



Media buyers who just 'set and forget'

Those who blame the algorithm when things don't work

Anyone who can't explain WHY a campaign is working (or not)

People who aren't comfortable with high stakes and tight targets



Compensation & Benefits



Monthly Salary: $1,500/month



Plus:



Monthly performance bonuses tied to company Operating Profit (5-25% of salary)

Quarterly profit pool distribution (2-7.5% of company profits shared among team)

Remote-first environment (European timezone preferred)

Work with a team of A-players who actually give a damn

Direct founder access—no layers of bureaucracy

Real ownership of your domain—we don't micromanage



Our Hiring Process



We don't waste time—yours or ours. Here's how it works:



Step 1: Application (You're here!)

Step 2: Initial Interview with Founder

Step 3: Internal Assessment by Rescale

Step 4: WhatsApp update for next steps

Step 5: Signing of Independent Contractor and NDA

Step 6: Onboarding and Training



Total timeline: 1 week from application to offer.



Ready to Apply?



[ 
 ]



Complete the application form above. Be thorough—this is your first impression.



P.S.



Our best media buyer once found a winning audience that nobody else was targeting. It scaled to 6-figures in spend. If you have stories like that, we want to hear them.



P.P.S.



If you're reading this far, you're already more thorough than 90% of applicants. That's exactly who we want.

title: AIRBNB PROPERTY MANAGER COHOST
description:
Commitment: Full-time (8 hours per day, 7 days per week)

Start Date: ASAP



About the Role:

We are a growing short-let property business based in the UK, managing multiple Airbnb listings. We are looking for a reliable and experienced Virtual Assistant (VA) to fully support and manage the day-to-day operations of our Airbnb properties.



This is a full-time role that requires a daily commitment (7 days a week), strong communication skills, and a solid understanding of the short-let rental business. You will be a key part of our team, ensuring smooth operations and excellent guest experiences.



Please note: This must be your only job. We require full attention and availability to support our operations.



Key Responsibilities:



Daily Tasks:



* Respond promptly to guest messages and booking inquiries on Airbnb and other platforms

* Confirm bookings and monitor availability calendars

* Review and update front-end listings daily to ensure accurate pricing, visibility, and bookability

* Coordinate with cleaning and maintenance teams to ensure properties are guest-ready

* Monitor guest check-ins and check-outs, ensuring smooth transitions and issue resolution

* Track and report daily task completion, guest interactions, and progress on ongoing issues

* Ensure keys and access details are properly managed and communicated



Weekly Tasks:



* Review upcoming reservations and coordinate logistics

* Follow up with vendors and cleaners for feedback and issue resolution

* Ensure supplies and consumables are stocked or restocked where needed

* Update guest manuals, listing descriptions, and SOPs if necessary

* Prepare and send weekly reports summarizing operations, occupancy, and performance



Monthly Tasks:



* Track KPIs such as occupancy rates, reviews, and guest satisfaction

* Assist with monthly expenses and supplier/vendor tracking

* Identify recurring problems and propose solutions to improve efficiency

* Contribute to operational improvements and SOP updates



Additional Responsibilities:



* Assist in sourcing new short-let units and growing the business

* Provide basic support with social media marketing and online visibility

* Support the business owner with general administrative tasks as needed



Requirements:



* At least 1 year of experience working as a VA for Airbnb or a short-let property management business

* Excellent written and spoken English

* Strong organisational and time-management skills

* Proficient with tools like Google Drive, Google Sheets, and online communication platforms

* Familiar with Airbnb (calendar, messaging, resolution centre, etc.)

* Self-motivated, dependable, and able to handle tasks independently

* Flexibility to handle urgent matters, especially during peak guest hours

* Must not have other job commitments; this is a dedicated full-time role



Working Hours:



* 8 hours per day, 7 days a week

* Flexible schedule, but availability must align with UK guest needs (mornings, afternoons, or evenings as required)

* Occasional urgent requests may need handling outside regular hours



What We Offer:



* Long-term role with room for growth

* Clear documentation and training provided

* Supportive and collaborative work environment

* Potential for bonuses and pay increases based on performance



To Apply:

Please send your CV and a short cover letter explaining your experience with Airbnb and why you're a good fit for this role. Only applicants with direct experience in short-let or Airbnb property management will be considered.

title: YOUTUBE CREATIVE DIRECTOR (Long-Form Video Editor + Thumbnails / YouTube Strategy)
description:
WHO WE ARE & WHY THIS ROLE MATTERS

Hey there! We're looking for a YouTube Creative Director based in Davao City to work closely with

established business owners, YouTube entrepreneurs, business coaches, and content

creators — producing content that drives engagement and real business growth.



You'll be part of the core team and an active collaborator in content ideation,

planning, and execution, making sure every video aligns with the client's brand

and business goals. This is a hands-on creative role: you'll live in the edit,

shape the story, and help d
 what gets made — not just manage from the sidelines.



WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING

- Edit long-form video — talking-head content, podcasts, and interview-style

  videos — with strong pacing, story flow, b-roll, captions, and retention editing

- Work directly with the CEO and team to shape the video content roadmap

- Develop and refine content ideas that align with the client's brand and goals

- Help with content creation end to end — from ideation and scripting to editing

  and publishing — while keeping the client's voice

- Research and integrate YouTube growth strategies into content planning

- Collaborate with the production team to optimize content for the YouTube algorithm

- Analyze performance and adjust strategy to maximize views, engagement, conversions

- Ad hoc tasks as needed, e.g. building presentations in Miro, Google Slides, or

  similar tools that turn client ideas into visually engaging narratives



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR — NON-NEGOTIABLES

- Proven experience editing LONG-FORM video — talking heads, podcasts, interviews

  (please include samples or a portfolio)

- Strong command of YouTube-style editing: pacing, hooks, b-roll, captions, retention

- PLUS at least ONE of the following:

   - Thumbnail design — eye-catching, click-worthy YouTube thumbnails, OR

   - YouTube strategy — titles, packaging, SEO, analytics, and channel growth

- Excellent English communication and comfort collaborating directly with the CEO

  and clients

- Data-driven and analytical, but also intuitive and trend-aware

- Comfortable with a fluid schedule and the occasional urgent request



BONUS POINTS IF YOU HAVE

- Based in or near Davao City — we have a studio there, so being local is a real plus

- Background in marketing, branding, or viral content creation

- Experience managing and growing YouTube channels

- Knowledge of YouTube SEO and monetization

- Organized enough to juggle multiple projects, flexible enough to pivot when

  inspiration (or an urgent client need) strikes



We value diverse perspectives and experiences. If you connect with this role but

don't tick every box, we still encourage you to apply — sometimes the perfect

voice comes from an unexpected place.



WHY JOIN US

- Be part of a high-growth team scaling fast — you'll play a key role in making it happen

- Creative freedom and real input on strategy and execution

- Grow your career and skills in YouTube marketing, content strategy, and digital business

- Supportive, remote-first culture with teammates across the Philippines and beyond

- Make a real impact — your content will inspire, educate, and change lives for

  people building online businesses



THE OFFER AT A GLANCE

- No time Tracker 

- 13th-month bonus from Day 1

- Performance bonuses tied to content growth

- HMO, dental, mental health & telemedicine (eligible after 6-month tenure)

- Paid week-long Christmas leave + PTO + birthday gift

- Trust-based culture — no time tracking, no micromanagement

- Workshops + financial & credit support



SCHEDULE & SETUP

Monday–Friday, 8 AM–4 PM PHT · Work-from-home



HOW TO APPLY

Send your resume/CV and a portfolio or 2–3 samples of long-form videos you've

edited (talking head/podcast preferred). If you also do thumbnails or YouTube

strategy, include examples of that too. To show you've read this, start your

application with the word "STORYTELLER."

title: Property Deal Sourcing Assistant (UK R2R/Arbitrage Focus)
description:
I'm a UK-based property investor and deal sourcer specialising in rent-to-rent serviced accommodation and HMO deals. I'm looking for a part-time virtual assistant to take ownership of the full back-end workflow once a deal is identified — from analysis through to investor sign-off.



This is not a general VA role. I need someone who understands UK property, knows what makes a deal stack, and can work independently without hand-holding.



What you'll be doing:



- Running deal analysis (yield, ROI, cashflow projections) using spreadsheet templates or software

- Building professional deal packs in Canva or similar — ready to send to investors

- Posting deals to UK property
 groups and managing responses

- Liaising with investors — answering questions, following up, keeping them warm

- Sending out agreements, NDAs and reservation forms and tracking signatures

- Managing the deal workflow from analysis to completion

- Keeping a clean investor CRM — logging interest, criteria and follow-up dates





What I'm looking for:



- Genuine UK property knowledge and familiar with Rent to Rent/ Arbitrage Model

- Previous experience in property deal sourcing or deal packaging, even if in a support role

- Strong written English for investor-facing communication

- Comfortable with Canva, Google Sheets and a CRM

- Highly organised, proactive, and able to manage your own workload

- Available during UK business hours for at least part of the week





Hours & Pay:

- Part-time, up to 10 hours per week to start, with room to grow.

- Competitive rate based on experience — please include your expected hourly rate when applying.



To apply, please send:



- A short introduction (3–5 sentences max) — who you are and your property background

- One example of deal analysis or a deal pack you've worked on (even a sample is fine)

- Your expected hourly rate

title: Paid Advertising Specialist
description:
Tradelance is Australia’s first social marketplace connecting homeowners with trusted local tradespeople. We have just launched on the Apple App Store and Google Play and are now running paid campaigns to drive sign-ups, app downloads, and Pro membership conversions. This is a high-impact role with direct influence on the company’s growth from day one.



What You Will Be Doing

• Set up, manage, and optimize paid ad campaigns across Meta Ads 
 & Instagram), Google Ads, TikTok Ads, and Apple Search Ads

• Drive app downloads, account sign-ups, and Pro membership conversions across all platforms

• Set up and manage Apple Search Ads to ensure Tradelance ranks at the top when users search our name

• Research and bid on our brand name and relevant keywords to maximize App Store placement and visibility

• Set up conversion tracking, pixel configuration, and ensure all data is flowing and reporting correctly

• Monitor campaign performance daily and report weekly such as CTR, CPC, ROAS, cost per sign-up, and conversions

• A/B test ad creatives, copy, audiences, and bidding strategies to continuously improve performance

• Work closely with the Head of Operations to align paid campaigns with the overall launch and growth strategy



What We Are Looking For

• Proven experience running paid ad campaigns on Meta Ads Manager and Google Ads results are mandatory

• Experience with Apple Search Ads or Google App Campaigns is a strong advantage

• Strong understanding of conversion tracking, Meta Pixel, Google Tag Manager, and analytics

• Data driven mindset you make decisions based on numbers, not assumptions

• Experience optimizing campaigns specifically for app downloads and account sign-ups

• Knowledge of keyword bidding strategies and App Store placement optimization

• Excellent communication able to explain campaign performance clearly to non-technical stakeholders

• Organized and able to manage multiple campaigns across multiple platforms simultaneously



Familiarity with the following tools is highly regarded:

• Meta Ads Manager 

• Google Ads 

• Apple Search Ads 

• TikTok Ads 

• Google Tag Manager 

• Meta Pixel

• Metricool 

• Google Analytics 

• Notion 

• Trello 

• Slack 

• Instantly

• Adobe



Nice to Have

• Google Ads or Meta Blueprint certification

• Experience working with Australian brands or audiences
