title: Dental Technician
description:
Job Description: Dental Technician

Job Title: Dental TechnicianDepartment: 

Dental Laboratory / Production

Reports To: Senior Dental Technician / Laboratory 

ManagerEmployment Type: Full-time / Part-time / 



Job Summary

We are looking for a skilled and detail-oriented Dental Technician to join our team. You will work closely with dentists and dental professionals to design, fabricate, and repair custom dental appliances such as crowns, bridges, dentures, orthodontic appliances, and implants. Using specialized tools, materials, and techniques, you will ensure all products meet high standards of quality, functionality, aesthetics, and clinical requirements, while adhering to safety and regulatory guidelines.



Key Responsibilities

Fabricate, adjust, and repair dental prosthetics including crowns, bridges, partial/full dentures, veneers, inlays/onlays, and orthodontic appliances based on prescriptions and impressions provided by dentists.

Interpret dental prescriptions, study models, digital scans, and design specifications to ensure accurate fit, function, and appearance.

Perform laboratory procedures: model pouring and trimming, waxing, casting, investing, polishing, finishing, and ceramic layering (as applicable).



Operate and maintain dental laboratory equipment such as articulators, casting machines, furnaces, milling machines, 3D printers, and digital design software (e.g., CAD/CAM systems).



Select and prepare appropriate materials including ceramics, metals, acrylics, resins, and composites according to product requirements.

Inspect finished products for accuracy, quality, and compliance with standards; make necessary adjustments or corrections.



Collaborate with dentists and clinical teams to resolve fit or design issues and ensure patient satisfaction.

Maintain accurate records of work orders, materials used, and production timelines.

Follow all safety protocols, infection control procedures, and regulatory requirements (e.g., FDA, ISO) to ensure a safe working environment.



Stay updated with new techniques, materials, and technologies in dental technology through training and professional development.

Qualifications

Education & Training

Diploma, Certificate, or Associate Degree in Dental Technology, or a related field from an accredited institution.

Relevant professional certification or license (as required by local regulatory bodies) is preferred.



Experience

Entry-level: 2 years of experience in a dental laboratory or related field (training provided for qualified candidates).

Experienced: 2+ years of hands-on experience fabricating dental prosthetics; proficiency in specific areas (e.g., ceramics, removable prosthetics, CAD/CAM) is an advantage.

Technical Skills

Knowledge of dental anatomy, occlusion, and materials science.

Proficiency in manual techniques: waxing, carving, casting, polishing, and finishing.

Experience with CAD/CAM technology and digital workflow is highly desirable.

Ability to use and maintain dental laboratory tools and equipment safely.

Strong hand-eye coordination, manual dexterity, and attention to fine detail.

Soft Skills

Precision and attention to detail to ensure high-quality output.

Good problem-solving skills to address design or fit challenges.

Effective communication skills to coordinate with dental professionals and team members.

Time management and ability to meet production deadlines.

Commitment to quality, safety, and continuous learning.

Working Conditions

Work is performed primarily in a dental laboratory setting; involves standing for extended periods and working with small, detailed components.

Exposure to materials such as dust, chemicals, and heat; proper protective equipment (PPE) is provided and required.

May involve occasional lifting of materials or equipment (up to 10–15 kg).

Standard working hours, with possible overtime during peak production periods.

Benefits

Competitive salary based on experience and skills.

Health insurance and other statutory benefits.

Opportunities for training, certification, and career advancement.

Safe and well-equipped working environment.

Professional development support.

title: Video Editor
description:
We’re looking for a full-time video editor to help us scale a portfolio of ecommerce brands.



You do NOT need ecommerce experience, but you MUST already know the basics of editing. We care way more about hunger, creativity, and pride in your work than a perfect resume. If you obsess over making content look clean, engaging, and high-converting, you’ll fit right in here.



This is not a “clock in, collect a paycheck, clock out” type of role. We want killers. People who actually want to improve, take ownership, and grow with the team. You’ll work directly with me and the team to get hands-on guidance to level up fast as an editor and creator.



There will be busy seasons like Black Friday and holidays where we move fast and push hard, but we reward people who step up. We have strong bonus structures in place for people who go above and beyond.

UGC Videos (talking head + supporting B-roll)

• Reliable, high-speed internet is a must!

• Candidates should have access to a computer with Microsoft Windows installed!

This is not a multi-tasking role. This is not appointment setting on the side. Your entire shift is finding people and getting them to apply. If you can't stay locked in on a single mission, do not apply.

Why This Is an Easy Sell



You won't be recruiting for some sink-or-swim operation. We hand every new agent FREE leads — they don't pay for them and they don't have to cold-prospect from scratch. The math is simple: an agent who puts in a real 8–10 hour day and actually works the leads we give them has a near-certain shot at making money in their first month. That's your pitch. You're not begging people to take a gamble — you're offering them a real opportunity with the leads, training, and support already in place. Use that.

What You'll Actually Do

Start real conversations, handle replies, and drive candidates to fill out our application

Hit daily outreach volume and track everything



Who I'm NOT Looking For



People who "think they can figure it out"

People doing two or three other jobs at the same time

People who send 10 messages and call it a day

People who need to be micromanaged



Who I AM Looking For



Proven recruiting, sourcing, or high-volume outreach experience — and you can prove it with numbers

Someone who treats this like their own business and stays locked in for the full shift

Strong written English and a confident, professional tone in messages

Reliable internet, quiet workspace, and zero excuses about showing up



Schedule

Your working hours must fall within 6:00 AM – 8:00 PM Pacific Standard Time (US hours) so you overlap with the US workday. This is non-negotiable.

Note: the sales agents you'll be recruiting work a minimum 8-hour day themselves — so you'll be looking for people ready to commit to real full-time work, not casual side hustlers.



Pay



Hourly base pay

Performance bonuses on top: you earn a bonus every time a recruit you brought in hits their sales targets. Bring me producers and your income climbs with theirs.

title: Cost Accountant
description:
Part-time Cost Accountant – Ostendo EAP Specialist, remote role

Part-time Cost Accountant – Ostendo & MYOB Specialist



 Part-time / Contract

 Fully remote — anywhere

 Ostendo + MYOB required

 Sportswear / Direct Import

 Schools & Sports Clubs

 Inventory & Ecommerce

 Data Cleanup Priority

About us



We are a New Zealand-based business supplying customised sportswear direct from China to schools and sports clubs. Sponsorship is a core part of how we serve our customers. Our operations run on Ostendo EAP integrated with MYOB, and we sell through both direct and ecommerce channels. We have an immediate need to address item code and data cleanup alongside ongoing finance and inventory management responsibilities.



About the role



This is a fully remote, part-time contract role open to candidates anywhere in the world. You will be the Ostendo and MYOB system expert on our team — working closely with our NZ-based bookkeeper and external accountant to ensure the financial and operational engine of the business is running accurately and to its full potential.



Who you'll work with: You'll collaborate directly with our in-house bookkeeper (day-to-day transactions and data entry) and our external accountant (compliance, tax, and period-end). Your role is the bridge — owning the EAP system, cost structures, inventory integrity, and reporting quality that both of them depend on.



Key responsibilities



Item code & data cleanup — immediate priority



Our item code library and product descriptions have accumulated significant duplication and inconsistency. This is a hands-on cleanup project with real urgency — server storage constraints mean it needs to be addressed promptly and methodically.



Audit the full item code library in Ostendo — identify duplicates, redundant codes, obsolete items, and inconsistent naming conventions

Standardise product descriptions across all active items — clear, consistent, and suitable for quotes, invoices, and ecommerce listings

Develop and apply a logical item coding structure that supports accurate reporting and scalable growth

Merge, archive, or delete redundant records — carefully managing linked transactions, open orders, and historical data before any removal

Identify and reduce unnecessary data accumulation contributing to server storage pressure

Document new item code conventions so the bookkeeper and team can maintain consistency going forward

Inventory management & stocktakes



Plan and coordinate monthly physical stocktakes with the local team — count sheets, variance investigation, and sign-off

Reconcile physical counts against Ostendo inventory records; investigate and resolve variances

Process inventory adjustments in Ostendo and ensure these are correctly reflected in MYOB

Maintain accurate stock valuations and monitor slow-moving or obsolete stock

Ecommerce inventory accuracy



Ensure inventory levels in Ostendo sync correctly with ecommerce platform(s) — preventing overselling or stockout errors

Review and tighten the ecommerce fulfilment workflow — order receipt, picking, dispatch, stock deduction, returns, and cancellations

Ensure cleaned-up item codes and descriptions flow correctly into ecommerce product listings

Stock receipting & MYOB integration



Manage end-to-end stock receipting in Ostendo — purchase order through to goods receipt and inventory posting

Ensure stock receipts and supplier invoices are reconciled and posted correctly into MYOB

Oversee the sales invoicing process — correct coding, GST treatment, and customer allocation in MYOB

Support the bookkeeper with transaction queries and system issues as they arise

Freight & import costing



Ensure landed costs (freight, customs, duties) on China direct imports are correctly captured and allocated to stock

Review freight links and integrations within Ostendo for accuracy

Costing, quoting & margin reporting



Review and validate the quoting module — ensure cost and selling prices are correctly configured for margin reporting

Maintain costing templates for consistent quoting on customised sportswear orders

Prepare margin and management reports for the business owner and external accountant as required

Sponsorship accounting

How to Apply:



- Message Mati on WhatsApp at 
and include the following:



A link to your portfolio showing previous work in the e-commerce space, along with details of who you worked for. You must also complete the test task below. Applications without both will not be considered.



Test Task:



- You are editing a 15-second AI UGC-style Meta ad for a skincare product called GlowBoost. GlowBoost is a daily face serum designed for women aged 50 and above that targets dull skin, uneven skin tone and loss of radiance.

- Your video must include an AI-generated UGC presenter who appears to be a woman in her 50s or older. She should look natural, relatable and trustworthy, not overly polished or corporate. Think real woman, real result.

- You must also include relevant B-roll layered appropriately throughout the video. Think mature skincare routines, close-ups of glowing healthy skin, product application and a woman looking confident in the mirror. 

- Captions and subtitles must be styled for silent viewing on mobile. 

- Background music should feel warm, calm and uplifting, suited to an older female audience. The video must end with a clear call to action.



The Script:



"At my age I thought dull skin was just something I had to live with, but GlowBoost actually changed that. Two weeks in and my skin looks brighter, more even. I genuinely wasn't expecting this. If you're in your 50s and struggling with your skin, just try it."



Format and Specs:



- The video must be exactly 15 seconds, no longer. Aspect ratio 9:
 vertical for
 and Instagram Reels and Stories. Export as MP4 and send via WhatsApp with your application.



What We Are Looking For:



We want to see that you have chosen a presenter who genuinely fits the target audience. Age, tone and relatability matter here. The B-roll should be relevant, well-timed and age-appropriate. Captions should be clean and easy to read. The hook should land within the first 2 to 3 seconds. The overall feel should be warm and authentic, something that would genuinely resonate with women aged 50 and above, and look like a real ad in someone's feed.



Please note we are not judging the product or the script as we wrote those. We are purely judging your editing, tool choices, creativity and attention to detail. Specifically we want to see that you can match a creative to the right audience.
